title: Create AI Decompose API endpoint for sub-question decomposition
acceptance_criteria: New POST endpoint at /problems/new/ai-decompose/ (or similar URL under judge app) accepts JSON body with 'description' (problem text) and optionally 'max_sub_questions' (default 5)
Endpoint requires authentication and create_private_problem permission (same as problem creation)
Calls LLM with profile='grading' to analyze the problem description and propose sub-questions

LLM prompt instructs: given a problem description, decompose into independent scoring dimensions (sub-questions), each with a label, suggested max score (summing to suggested total), and brief reference/key points
Returns JSON array of proposed sub-questions: [{label, score, reference}, ...]
Handles LLM errors gracefully: returns HTTP 502 with error message on failure
Implements retry logic: HTTP 429/500/502/503/504 → exponential backoff (1s, 5s, 25s), max 3 retries
CSRF protection enabled (standard Django POST endpoint pattern)
Rate limiting: reuses existing judge rate-limit infrastructure if available
deliverables: New URL route in judge/urls.py (or appropriate urls module)
New view function in judge/views/ (or appropriate views module)
